verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a REST API reference: the Search API page covers authentication headers and retry strategy, and there is an API reference landing page for the official clients. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
